The F.P. Journe Vertical Tourbillon Souverain Boutique Edition is encased in 42mm of rose gold surrounding a blackened solid gold dial with enamel sub dials on a leather strap with a rose gold folding clasp. Features of this F.P. Journe Vertical Tourbillon Souverain include remontoir constant force device, hours, minutes, sub-seconds, power reserve indicator, and 30-second tourbillon. This F.P. Journe watch also measures 13.8mm in thickness and 51.7mm from lug-to-lug.
